column1: # Battle / system messages built by concatenation (MegatenCanvas Battle_*). JP regex (anchored) TAB EN template.
# {1},{2} = captured groups; each is translated again (names are already English via the ID tables).
# ORDER MATTERS: the first match wins, so specific templates go above generic ones.
# Name captures exclude Japanese sentence punctuation; status templates only take the real ailment names, so story text can't match by accident.
# Battle lines are drawn one by one without wrapping: keep them short (about 37 chars with a long name).
# --- Turn-start ailment lines: Battle_Character.Name + "は" + status (status fragments are in system.tsv)
([^、。「」『』…\n]+)は(しびれて動けない|凍って動けない|金縛りで動けない|石化で動けない|眠っている|浮かれている|混乱している|魅了されている)
# --- Split two-line messages: "{name}は" on one line and "{item}を使った" on the next
# --- Generic skill use: keep last among the "の" templates
(\d+)ポイント振り分けてください
